//: Copy to config.json and fill in. All resources are created fresh in YOUR tenant.

fabric.//capacityId: REQUIRED. Existing Fabric capacity resource id or capacity GUID. A workspace cannot be created without a capacity (F-SKU or Trial).
fabric.//siteCount: OPTIONAL. Number of extra synthetic sites to fan out from the reference site after data load (0 = single reference site only). Each new site is healthy/stable; capped at the built-in site catalog (12).

//fixedIdentity: OPTIONAL. A service principal (with a client secret) used as the Import semantic model's data-source identity so it can refresh from the Lakehouse SQL endpoint. If provided, deploy binds a connection + refreshes automatically; otherwise do it manually (see README).

foundry.//models: Deployment name | catalog model | version | format | capacity
